_comment: Reviewed exceptions for tools/license_audit.py (docs/SPEC.md 13.4). Each entry needs license (SPDX as reviewed), reason and evidence (https URLs). Sections: python (by distribution name), npm (by package name), native (by component name as listed in NATIVE_COMPONENTS). An exception can never accept GPL / AGPL / LGPL for a package; for native components it records a deliberate, visible decision. Keep this file small.

native.reason: python-soundfile (BSD-3-Clause, core dependency) loads libsndfile as a separate, unmodified, user-replaceable shared library through cffi; MankoMIX does not bundle or redistribute it. This is weaker than SPEC 13.1 ('LGPL only as an external process'), which D-057 applied strictly to soxr. Options: accept dynamic loading of unmodified LGPL libraries for audio I/O, or move decoding/encoding to the external FFmpeg process.
MP3 codecs compiled into the libsndfile that soundfile wheels bundle; same situation and decision as libsndfile.
